title: Index a project against its active build config
summary: Parses a project index against the project's active build config (the .dproj Config marker or delphilsp.json) instead of a fixed Release, with an override flag
intro: Read this when a project index must show the code your IDE compiles, for example IFDEF DEBUG branches, or when you want to index a specific build such as Release for a ship view. The index follows the project's active configuration and records it, so a config switch re-parses exactly that database.

questions.ask: How do I index my project as the build the IDE has active?
How do I index the Release build while Debug is active?
